user.title: Set up Puppy Weight Tracker
user.description: Set up Puppy Weight Tracker to register and monitor puppy weights.

abort.already_configured: Puppy Weight Tracker is already configured.

manage_litter.title: Manage litter
manage_litter.description: Select the litter you want to manage.

edit_litter.title: Edit litter
edit_litter.description: Edit litter details, archive or restore the litter, or permanently delete it.

data_description.name: Name of the litter
data_description.action: Choose what you want to do with this litter

confirm_delete_litter.title: Permanently delete litter
confirm_delete_litter.description: You are about to permanently delete {name}. This litter contains {puppies} puppies and {measurements} stored measurements. This cannot be undone.

data.confirm: I understand and want to permanently delete this litter

add_puppy.title: Add puppy
add_puppy.description: Add a puppy to an existing litter.

data_description.litter_id: Select the litter this puppy belongs to
data_description.name: For example Red, Blue, or a temporary name
data_description.birth_weight: Weight immediately after birth in grams
data_description.birth_time: Exact date and time of birth if known

manage_puppy.title: Manage puppy
manage_puppy.description: Select the puppy you want to manage.

edit_puppy.title: Edit puppy
edit_puppy.description: Edit puppy details, archive or restore the puppy, or permanently delete it.

data_description.name: Name or identification name of the puppy
data_description.birth_time: Exact date and time of birth
data_description.action: Choose what you want to do with this puppy

confirm_delete_puppy.title: Permanently delete puppy
confirm_delete_puppy.description: You are about to permanently delete {name}. This puppy has {measurements} stored measurements. This cannot be undone.

data.confirm: I understand and want to permanently delete this puppy

settings.title: Monitoring settings
settings.description: Configure when Puppy Weight Tracker should flag a puppy for attention. The default minimum growth threshold is 5% per 24 hours during the first 14 days.

data_description.min_daily_growth_percent: Flag normalized daily growth below this percentage. General veterinary guidance describes approximately 5–10% daily weight gain as normal during the neonatal period.
data_description.max_hours_between_weighings: Flag a puppy when no new weight has been recorded within this number of hours.
data_description.growth_monitoring_days: After this age the minimum daily growth threshold is no longer applied. Weight loss can still be flagged.

manage_measurements.title: Manage measurements
manage_measurements.description: Select the puppy whose stored weighings you want to inspect or manage.

select_measurement.title: Select measurement
select_measurement.description: {puppy} has {count} stored measurement records. 🗑 means deleted and ↪ means superseded by a correction.

edit_measurement.title: Manage measurement
edit_measurement.description: {puppy}: {measurement}. A correction never overwrites the old record; the original remains stored as history.

data_description.timestamp: Date and time when this weighing was performed.
data_description.reason: Optional explanation stored in the audit log.
data_description.action: Correct, delete, or restore this measurement.

confirm_delete_measurement.title: Delete measurement
confirm_delete_measurement.description: You are about to delete this measurement for {puppy}: {measurement}. The measurement is only soft-deleted and remains stored in history. If this is the birth-weight measurement, the puppy birth-weight field is cleared as well.

error.invalid_litter: The selected litter no longer exists.

error.invalid_settings: One or more monitoring settings are invalid.
error.invalid_measurement: The selected measurement no longer exists or cannot be changed in its current state.

abort.no_measurements: There are no stored measurements for this puppy yet.
